curation_protocol: INTERIM, NOT FOR SUBMISSION. Recovery and label correction described in dataset/derived_from_legacy/README_INTERIM.md. Built only to exercise the pipeline and size the revision experiments. Mixed-label homology clusters dropped, not relabelled.

sources.name: AMPBenchmark-negatives-curated
sources.version: unrecorded (interim recovery from legacy split CSVs)
sources.license: unverified (interim source; licence to be confirmed from the official export)
sources.prefilter_provenance: Recovered on 2026-09-05 from the legacy dataset/{train,val,test}.csv files by grouping rows on their record-identifier family; the original database export was not available. Membership in the named database is asserted by the record identifier only, not by a verified download. This is an interim source and must be replaced by the genuine export, with its own release version, retrieval date and hash, before any reportable run. Curation applied 2026-09-05: all sequences belonging to the 186 homology clusters that mixed AMP and non-AMP labels were REMOVED (6,273 sequences). No sequence was relabelled.
sources.label_definition: AMP=0: negative-sampling output distributed with AMPBenchmark. Every record identifier names its sampling method and declares AMP=0. The legacy dataset stored all 69,140 of these rows as positives; that inversion is the fault this build corrects.
